The '''Thila system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thila/Legends|Thila]].
